before.name: Bill Tilton
before.description: Member of the Alexandria raiding team arrested in the July 10, 1970 Minnesota Eight actions. Convicted Nov 5, 1970 and sentenced to five years in federal prison; released July 1973. At sentencing he told Judge Devitt he was 'a good German' enabling fascism. He later became a St. Paul attorney.

before.name: Chuck Turchick
before.description: Chuck Turchick participated in the Minnesota Eight draft-board raids of July 10, 1970. Convicted with Bill Tilton, he received a five-year sentence. Minnesota Historical Society places the defendants’ actual terms between fourteen and twenty months and their release in July 1973. The ten-day contempt episode attributed to Turchick in the earlier biography concerned Brad Beneke.
